observation: The gunshot sounds were really quiet and really short; the glass-breaking sounds were sometimes too quiet or short
telemetry_context: Eight gunshot trials produced 10 active frames in total and two were inactive; five glass trials produced 15 active frames with one inactive and one having only one active frame
scoring_impact: Retain every predeclared score but interpret misses as combined stimulus-delivery temporal-coverage and classifier failures rather than pure classification errors
next_design_implication: Before another scored run qualify board-side activity coverage and use longer repeated transient sequences or source clips that span multiple inference windows without clipping
